sample_frame: Primary sampling units are voting precincts; secondary selection units are adults registered on electoral lists. 2017 fieldwork also re-approached the 2012 panel and added an age-18-to-22 dwelling-based supplement.
actual_sampling_design: Stratified two-stage probability sampling. Stage 1: 150 voting-precinct PSUs selected PPS by number of registered adults within strata. Stage 2: 10 registered electors selected by systematic equal-probability sampling from each selected precinct electoral list. Panel recontact and age-18-to-22 supplement are positively documented.
psu_strata_cluster_route_detail: Strata: 18 socio-cultural areas crossed with locality type/size. PSU=voting precinct. PPS size=registered adults. Stage-2 systematic sampling from electoral lists. 2012 panel: 4-visits algorithm, minimum 1050/1504 target. Supplement: one age-18-to-22 respondent per PSU via next dwelling and next-birthday selection when needed.
